summary: ANNA AF SANDS VENNEFORENING (org. no. 996 316 688) is an association (FLI) based in Sola, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2010-12-18. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Per-Allan Røsand.
